description: The Collective plugin marketplace — operator safety hooks and workflow skills for Claude Code.

plugins.name: collective
plugins.description: The Collective operator safety floor for Claude Code: a catastrophic-command denylist (recursive root deletion, DROP DATABASE, fork bombs, force-push to protected branches, etc.) plus a protected-file guard, bundled with the c-* workflow skills. The hook scripts run locally, make no network calls and read no credentials — a PreToolUse check on Bash commands whose every denial says how to proceed when the matched pattern was only text the command carried, an Edit/Write guard on platform-safety files, a UserPromptSubmit claim-gate contract, and a PostToolUse check that, only inside a Collective-governed repo and only when a new commit's message carries an acceptance-criterion tag (ac:<id>), reads the commit SHA and asks the agent to record it via the collective MCP server, and a PostToolUse check that, after a claude.ai Artifact publish, reads the published local file's size, hash and title and asks the agent to mirror it into The Collective (claude.ai artifacts are readable only by the account that published them). What leaves the machine: each Bash command Claude Code is about to run is sent to the Collective server you connected, over your own signed-in collective MCP session, for the rules check (an mcp_tool hook that Claude Code runs; it is skipped while that server is not connected); and, when the agent acts on the two PostToolUse prompts, it sends the commit SHA, or the artifact's URL, size, hash and title, over the same session. The plugin sends nothing else and runs no background network calls.
